text:
jamie: thinking of running a low-key mezzanine LAN next Friday evening — speedrun corner + handheld swap. projector + a couple low-lag monitors. who can bring power strips / capture card / spare controllers? small prize (steam key) :grin:
maria: in. will bring BenQ projector, 2 long power strips, and a surge protector.
devin: i can bring an Elgato HD60 S capture card and an 8-port switch. need about 6ft clear table space.
nash: (meant ash) ash: count me for a Switch + extras (2 pro controllers, 3 joycons). can run a tiny MK8 bracket. :video_game:
sara: snacks here — vegan + gluten-free options. also donating 2 steam keys for prizes :trophy: happy to help with signups.
luca: i've got a weird box of adapters: PS2->HDMI, Dreamcast VGA->HDMI, plus a lag tester and a CRT-style monitor if anyone wants throwback vibes.
jamie: lovely. @maria @devin can you both bring cat6 cables? i'd like wired for the speedrun corner to avoid wifi spikes.
maria: yep i have cat6 and a cable tester.
devin: will bring 10ft+ cat6s and some gaffer tape for cable runs.
luca: quick outlet map for the mezz (so we don't overload):
```
North wall: 4 outlets (two banks)
South window: 2 outlets
Projector wall: 1 GFCI (avoid overloading)
Mezz table leg: power tap outlet
```

ash: also, does the mezz have folding chairs? i can bring 4 if needed. projector only has 1 HDMI in — anyone with an HDMI switch?
maria: i can bring an HDMI switch (3->1).
sara: i'll check room capacity and post a tiny google form for signups.
jamie: perfect. i'll make the calendar invite and pin the signup. ops-bot: can you create the event for Fri 7pm and reserve mezzanine?
ops-bot: Created event "Mezzanine LAN & Speedrun" for 2024-06-07 19:00–23:00 and reserved the mezzanine booking.
luca: pro tip: if using older handhelds bring small USB power banks + 5V 2A adapters — saves charging headaches.
nash: (meant ash) ash: noted. i'll bring 4 chairs and napkins. vegetarian snacks please @sara :salad:
jamie: thanks all 94 i'll drop a checklist in the event: projector, capture card, hdmi switch, cat6, power strips, chairs, snacks. if you can bring something, mark it in the event so we can cross it off. see you friday! :party_popper:
